braindump:entries.thoughts:
I like doing both reading and gaming... after a long day, there's not much that beats sinking into a good game or a good book.   |  Both hobbies travel well because for gaming, I'd have access to either a handheld console such as a Steam Deck or a full-blown gaming laptop, and for reading, I'd have access to physical books or the Kindle app on my devices (which is enough to hold a full library on my phone. )

I'd eventually like to dial-down my screen time by 80%, replacing it with reading or gaming.  

Here's the benefits of Kindle:
0 Access to hundreds of books on a lightweight device like a phone.
0 Perfect for travel, commuting, or reading in bed.
0 You can read faster.
0 There's gadgets out there that can hold your phone/kindle and even swipe the pages for you without you having to touch the screen.
0 You can also read in the dark without disturbing anyone.
0 You can adjust the brightness + add a warm light filter on newer models.
0 Buy, download, and start reading a new book within seconds and even syncs across devices.
0 Books are also considerably cheaper on Kindle and you have access to a paid subscription called Kindle Unlimited for if you read a lot.
0 You can also highlight, look up words, and take notes easily.

An idea I have is to go to a book store like Barnes N Noble and just look around for books that I may be interested in.  Once I find a book, I'll take a photo of it and later on search it up on Amazon so I can get it cheaper on Kindle.

braindump:entries.thoughts:
For my new writing dashboard:

I want to store the Writing Dashboard as a page inside of my Business Tab.  Once I click on the Writing Dashboard page, it'll show me a visual board when I can see all of my manuscripts, filtered by active, inactive, idea, series, etc.   I can drag and move around manuscripts and completely edit them, and I can view the stories structure and info at a glance.   I want it to also be grouped by Series, since I write Trilogies.  With each series and manuscript, I want to be able to see the following stats as well:
- Total Tasks
- Completed Tasks
- A completed task bar that can be edited for things like color
- Platform
- Niche
- Estimated Growth Duration 
- Goal Revenue
- Goal Profits
- Today's Goal - Example... 750  /  1,500 words.  <  This can be edited.
- Current Chapter
- Multiple editable and moveable note sections

Now, while still on the main page of the Writing Dashboard page, I want to place a whole article-like section of text and callouts above the visual board mentioned above.  I want it to have an actual title, such as "Your Novel in 30 Days".   I want everything to be moveable and adjustable and editable.  

Below that and the visual board, I want a Database Table Inline view that lists all of the tasks associated with my writing projects and I want the dashboard to be linked to the visual board database.  For the Tasks Inline View, I want to be able to insert templates, which are a page, then however many sub-pages I want and for each page I want there to be a summary note of the task and a button to open the page/task and when I click on any of those pages, I want to be able to add entire sections of text in the press of a button and sections of code blocks as well with the press of another button.  As usual, I want all of that to be editable and moveable.

Now back to the Writing Dashboard page, I want there to be clickable pages at the top for things like this:
- Outlines ( where I can store my example outline templates and create new ones. )
- Idea's ( where I can store any ideas I may have and filter them in various ways. )
- More Notes ( where I can store any additional notes and links to web pages and videos. )
- Theme Marketplace ( where I can store and choose from built-in themes or create my own, which changes colors, fonts, icons, backgrounds, etc. )
- Potential Automation ideas 

----

Now back to the Visual Board database.  When I click on a series or manuscript, I want to see these things:

01. an Intelligent Binder Navigation system like Scriveners.  Everything can be dragged anywhere. But set up like this:

Part I

Chapter 1

02. A Plot Thread Tracker that gets filled out as I insert text.

03. A Continuity Tracker that gets filled out as I insert text.

04. A Character Consistency Tracker that gets filled out as I insert text ( per character ).

05. An index card in the center where I can insert the entire chapter or text.   One for each chapter.

06. A Composition Mode that comes with the Index Card, similar to Scriveners that hides the Toolbars, Menus, Notifications, leaving only my manuscript on screen.  

07. I want a section on the right of the Index Card for general notes about the chapter, and on the left of the Index Card, I want the section that has the auto-filled Trackers mentioned above. 

08. A Project Targets Tracker at the top so I can track my progress visually, such as like this:
Entire manuscript: 100,000 words
Chapter: 2,500 words
Daily writing: 1,000 words
Then a tracking bar

09. The ability to compile the entire manuscript or specific chapters and export them in the following ways:
DOCX (Microsoft Word)
PDF
EPUB
Kindle-compatible formats
Rich Text (RTF)
Plain text
Final manuscript layouts

10.  Automatic Sync so it syncs my work across my computer and phone.

For my main page pillar, I want a Today Dashboard, which houses all of the data across the entire Personal Dashboard, including things like a Habit Tracker.  That Habit Tracker has properties with it like "Shows completion status", "Tracks streaks", Journaling, Recovery, Workout Completed, Hours Slept, etc.  Then, it also has a Win of the Day
